fields.notes:
No sign-in is required. The app works fully offline.
If review needs guidance: open the app, select source/target languages, enter text, and tap Translate.

fields.description:
Translate Offline is a fast, privacy-focused translation app that works without an internet connection. 

• Offline translation — use it anywhere, even with no Wi-Fi
• Private by design — your text stays on your device
• Quick input — type or paste and get instant results
• Simple workflow — swap languages, copy results, and keep going. 

Supported languages include: English, Japanese, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Korean, and more.

Great for travel, studying, and everyday writing. 

If you have feedback or feature requests, contact support using the link below.
fields.promotionalText: New in this update: Japanese translation support.
fields.whatsNew:
Simpler language names

Languages now read as "Danish" and "Spanish" instead of "Danish (Latin, Denmark)", with Chinese (Simplified) and Chinese (Traditional) clearly separated. The list also keeps itself up to date as macOS adds new languages.

Also in this update

• Copy a translation with a single click, from the main window or from History
• Your language choices are remembered between launches
• History shows the language pair and when each translation happened
• Download a missing language directly from the app
• Clearer messages when a language pair isn't supported or isn't downloaded yet
• The panels no longer resize when a translation arrives
• Press Command-Y to open History
• Improved VoiceOver support throughout
